1. (Currently amended) A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin __derived from an inulin source selected from chicory and other plant sources having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher__; and allowing the cement composition to set.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures up to about 280 *F __and maintains a viscosity that remains substantially constant during the thickening time period__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed __and the cement composition exhibits free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a suspension aid is not added to the cement composition __and the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition __at temperatures up to about 280 *F__.

6. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin __having a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3__.

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin __and the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin source selected from chicory and other plant sources__.

(Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition further comprises borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof __and does not comprise conventional retarder boosters__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a subterranean formation __at depths greater than 5,000 feet__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore __and the carboxylated inulin is the sole retarder booster additive__.
